title: 第17章 家族长老会第18章 一票之差形势逆转
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
“除非什么？”
“除非你这个女婿，开辟出了十方气海！”
“那不可能！”
韩正德连连摇头：“十方气海，那是传说当中才会存在，整个大隋皇朝，数万年的历史当中，都没有人开辟过，他怎么可能开辟的出来……”
“那你觉得除了这个解释，还有其他更合理的解释么？”
穆三娘没好气的说道。
韩正德沉默了。
的确！
一个御气五重，想要同时释放出三脉剑气，唯一的可能，便是楚天铭开辟出了十方气海！
难道他这个女婿，真的是个万年难遇的绝世天骄？
想到这里，韩正德不禁陷入了沉思当中……
“太好了，天铭赢了！”
韩清雪激动不已的欢呼起来。
之前，她还担心楚天铭会被韩枫所伤，可是哪里想到，天铭非但没事，反而真的成功挡下了韩枫的全部攻击！
这样的结果，让她如何不惊喜万分。
当然，此时最为震惊的，还是韩枫。
他呆立在原地，满脸不可思议的看着楚天铭，眼神里除了错愕，震惊，还有一丝丝不甘和愤怒。
他难以置信道：“怎么会这样，你这个瞎子修为不仅踏入了御气五重，而且还在这么短的时间里练成了九脉剑指……”
“韩枫，看来你这所谓的韩家第一天才，也不过如此！
1”

楚天铭自然不会解释，冷冷一笑：“韩枫，愿赌服输，将那株千年雪莲拿出来吧。”
韩枫紧紧攥了攥拳头，脸色难看到了极点。
对他来说，输了千年雪莲是小，但若是这件事情传扬出去的话，他不仅在韩家声望大降，而且多半会成为整个天河城的笑柄不可！
看到韩枫杵在原地，丝毫没有要拿出千年雪莲的意思，楚天铭嘴角一撇：“韩枫，这么多人，你不会是要耍赖吧？”
“千年雪莲么，我给你便是。”
韩枫冷哼一声，将那千年雪莲丢向了楚天铭。
楚天铭没有多想，伸手去接。
然而就在这时，韩枫眼里突然闪过一抹寒芒，毫无预兆，突然出手，一道掌印，径直向着楚天铭轰来。
楚天铭脸色一变，没想到韩枫这么无耻，想要闪躲，可是体内的真气，已经全部耗尽，双腿如灌了铅般，根本不听使唤，哪里能够避开。
眼看这一掌就要将他当场震毙。
演武场顿时惊呼四起。
韩清雪更是花容失色，大喊一声：“住手！”
说时迟，那时快。
一道身影闪电般出现在了楚天铭的身前。
砰！
一声闷响，韩枫的身影直接倒飞出三十多米，然后重重的摔在了演武场的地面之上，激起了漫天尘土。
众人一惊，急忙看去，只见救下楚天铭的不是别人，正是家主韩正德。
“家主，您怎么会……”
韩枫捂着胸口，神情痛苦的看着韩正德。
“哼，韩枫，身为韩家之人，竟然做出这种下三滥的举动，当真是败坏我韩家门风，若不是本家主早有防备，我的女婿就被你这种奸诈小人给害了！”

韩正德满脸严肃，眼含怒意。
content_en:
"Unless what?"
"Unless you, my son-in-law, have opened up the Ten Directions Sea of Qi!"
"That's impossible!"
Han Zhengde shook his head repeatedly: "The Ten Directions Qi Sea only exists in legends. No one has opened it up in the entire Sui Dynasty and tens of thousands of years of history. How could he open it up..."
"Then do you think there are other more reasonable explanations besides this explanation?"
Mu Sanniang said angrily.
Han Zhengde was silent.
indeed!
For a fifth-level Qi controler to release three veins of sword energy at the same time, the only possibility is for Chu Tianming to open up the ten directions of Qi sea!
Could it be that his son-in-law is really a genius that is rare to meet in a million years?
Thinking of this, Han Zhengde couldn't help but fell into deep thought...
"Great, Tianming wins!"
Han Qingxue cheered excitedly.
Before, she was worried that Chu Tianming would be injured by Han Feng, but she never expected that Tianming was not only fine, but actually successfully blocked all Han Feng's attacks!
Such a result made her extremely surprised.
Of course, the most shocked person at this time was Han Feng.
He stood there blankly, looking at Chu Tianming in disbelief. In addition to astonishment and shock, there was also a trace of unwillingness and anger in his eyes.
He said in disbelief: "How could this happen? Not only did you, a blind man, reach the fifth level of Qi Control, but you also developed the Nine Meridian Sword Fingers in such a short period of time..."
"Han Feng, it seems that your so-called Han family's number one genius is nothing more than that!
1”
Naturally, Chu Tianming would not explain, and smiled coldly: "Han Feng, if you are willing to admit defeat, take out the thousand-year-old snow lotus."
Han Feng clenched his fists tightly, his expression extremely ugly.
For him, losing to Thousand-Year Snow Lotus is a small thing, but if this matter spreads, not only will his reputation in the Han family plummet, but he will probably become the laughing stock of the entire Tianhe City!
Seeing Han Feng standing there with no intention of taking out the Millennium Snow Lotus, Chu Tianming curled his lips and said, "Han Feng, there are so many people here, are you trying to cheat?"
"Thousand-year-old snow lotus, I'll give it to you."
Han Feng snorted coldly and threw the thousand-year snow lotus towards Chu Tianming.
Chu Tianming didn't think much and reached out to pick it up.
However, at this moment, a cold light suddenly flashed in Han Feng's eyes. Without any warning, he suddenly took action, and a palm print went straight towards Chu Tianming.
Chu Tianming's face changed. He didn't expect Han Feng to be so shameless. He wanted to dodge, but all the energy in his body had been exhausted. His legs were like lead and they didn't obey his orders at all. There was no way he could avoid it.
Seeing that this palm was going to kill him on the spot.
The martial arts arena suddenly erupted in exclamations of surprise.
Han Qingxue's face turned pale and she shouted: "Stop!"
It's too late, but it's soon.
A figure appeared in front of Chu Tianming like lightning.
Bang!
With a muffled sound, Han Feng's figure flew backwards more than thirty meters, and then fell heavily to the ground of the martial arts arena, stirring up dust all over the sky.
Everyone was startled and looked around hurriedly, only to see that the person who rescued Chu Tianming was none other than the head of the family, Han Zhengde.
"Master, how could you..."
Han Feng covered his chest and looked at Han Zhengde with a painful expression.
"Hmph, Han Feng, as a member of the Han family, he did such a despicable act. It really ruined the family tradition of my Han family. If the head of the family hadn't been prepared, my son-in-law would have been harmed by a treacherous villain like you!"
Han Zhengde's face was serious and his eyes were filled with anger.
